text:
Ava: quick heads-up — I pushed a docs PR that standardizes SOC2 audit-log wording and swaps in a tiny SDK snippet for retention config. PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/482 :sparkles:
Maria: thanks — i'll review the legal language tomorrow. two quick q's: are we saying "default 90 days" or "minimum 90 days"?
Ava: leaning default 90 days, but note we allow customers to configure up to 7 years. want legal to OK phrase: "retained by default for 90 days; customer-configurable up to 7 years"
Jon: small nit — the current snippet uses `retention_days` as an int, but our SDK expects an ISO duration string for the v2 config. i'll add a migration note.
Sam: can we also add a one-line migration example for the JS SDK? a lot of customers hit this when migrating audit exports.
Ava: good call. i added this quick example in the PR body:```js
// new v2 SDK retention example
await client.setAuditRetention({
  exportRetention: 'P90D' // ISO-8601 duration = 90 days
});
```
Maria: looks fine to me; legal prefers we avoid saying "we delete" and use "retention is managed as follows". suggest: "Audit logs are retained by default for 90 days; customers may configure retention up to 7 years. Redwood provides tools to export and manage audit data."
Ava: i'll swap the phrasing. also fixed a broken docs link (the audit schema anchor changed). docs-bot: deployed link-check run, found 1 other broken anchor in /security/audit-logs.md.
docs-bot: link-check report: 1 failing anchor -> /security/audit-logs.md#event-schema (404).
Jon: i can fix the anchor in the schema section tonight, then update the PR. will also add a short note about how retention interacts with export snapshots.
Sam: can we add a small callout for Dedicated/Private customers to note that retention defaults are tenant-configurable and KMS keys are customer-owned for Private? keeps expectations clear.
Maria: yep include that as a compliance note. also tagging @Sam for the wording on KMS.
Ava: done — PR body updated and i added a small accordion in the page for Dedicated/Private differences.
Jon: pushed the anchor fix and updated the SDK snippet to use `P90D` in the docs code block. preview link: https://deploy-preview--482--redwood-docs.netlify.app/security/audit-logs
Ava: awesome. once legal thumbs, i'll merge and cut a short changelog entry.
Maria: thumbs up from legal. minor punctuation tweak but you're good to merge. :white_check_mark: 
Ava: merging after CI passes. thanks everyone!
Sam: thanks, will follow up with a short note to Solutions with the migration snippet. :mailbox_with_mail:
